headline: Violent Clashes Shatter Deadlock Across Linn Of Mercy And Central Fronts
war_summary: Breaking the territorial deadlock observed in yesterday's dispatch, combat across the central fronts has erupted into rapid operational movement, highlighted by sweeping base transitions in the Linn of Mercy. That sector has surged to become the focal point of active maneuvering, logging seventeen base exchanges over the past two hours as forces contest Fort Duncan, Lathair, Outwich Ranch, and surrounding redoubts. Meanwhile, raw attritional bloodletting has accelerated dramatically along the line: Dead Lands and the entrenched expanses of Weathered Expanse together registered over thirty thousand combined casualties in the latest two-hour reporting window, with bitter struggles persisting near Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow. To the east, Endless Shore and Marban Hollow maintain fierce turnover at Brackish Point and The Spitrocks, while coastal clashes continue to generate fresh friction across Farranac Coast, Stonecradle, and the Oarbreaker isles. Conversely, deep rear territories in the far north and southern interior remain entirely subdued behind the blazing frontline corridors.
